[[File:ChazwaStar-TLC2.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Chazwa (star)|Chazwa]] was a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]].]]
A '''dwarf star''' was a type of [[Star/Legends|star]]. [[Brown dwarf/Legends|Brown dwarfs]], [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarfs]] and [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarfs]] were all dwarf stars.<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref>
